# Lorem ipsum generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/lorem-ipsum/

Generate readable placeholder paragraphs for a layout, mockup or presentation. Choose the number of paragraphs and sentences you need.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Create three four-sentence paragraphs to check spacing in a card or content section.

## Limits and checks

The output combines a classic lorem ipsum opening with original neutral English sentences. Replace it before publishing final content.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
